content: {DRAFT} If a filter action is applied on a Ethernet frame (i.e. stream), the corresponding EthSwtStreamFilterAction has an Eth- SwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModification configured and the EthSwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModificationType is set to ETHSWT_STREAM_EGRESS_DESTINATION_OVERWRITE , then the egress destina- tion of this Ethernet frame shall be overwritten with the configured egress des- tination (see EthSwtStreamFilterActionDestinationPortModificationE- gressPortRef ).
